title: (Bug 641089) Guard Item Ledger/Value Entry No. allocation in Item Jnl.-Post Line with CommitBehavior::Ignore
summary: Item journal posting now prevents duplicate-key errors in concurrent scenarios by wrapping split posting in a commit-behavior guard frame, with an event for callers that need commits honored.
key_points: Split posting in Item Jnl.-Post Line now runs inside a CommitBehavior::Ignore frame, so Item Ledger and Value Entry numbers stay protected
New OnSetCommitBehavior event lets callers opt out and get the old commit behavior back
Follows the existing guard pattern in Gen. Jnl.-Post Line
Applied to the W1, APAC, CH, ES, IT and RU layers
Two tests check that commits are suppressed and that the opt-out works
